findings.title: Error IDs zipped with nodestore results by position, can misattribute events
findings.body: fetch_error_details zips `error_ids` with `events.values()` from nodestore get_multi. get_multi returns a dict keyed by node_id, and ordering or missing keys are not guaranteed to match the input list. Error details can therefore be attached to the wrong event id, or shifted when some ids are missing. Look up each result by its generated node_id instead of relying on position.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature check, and user id may be None
findings.body: The assemble analytics event is recorded before the feature-flag check, so requests that are rejected with 404 are still counted. Under org-auth-token auth, request.user is anonymous and `request.user.id` is None.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table renders empty data
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, TableWidgetVisualization is passed hardcoded empty columns and empty data instead of `result`. Every table widget then renders blank for orgs with the flag on.

findings.title: Static method on CommitContextIntegration references PRCommentWorkflow
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template is defined on CommitContextIntegration but calls `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title`. The helper is in the wrong class: the GitHub/GitLab PR comment workflows call `self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` and `self.get_environment_info`. If these methods don't resolve on the workflow class, that call raises AttributeError.

findings.title: Replay query 'field' params passed to process_raw_response may drop error_ids
findings.body: If the client sends `field` params, process_raw_response restricts the output to those fields. `error_ids` may then be missing, which silently disables error context.
